notes:
Account snapshot: Bastion Secure Assist is a payments-focused contact center platform used by dozens of banks and processors. Heavy PCI and PHI-ish data flows in support channels (tokenized PANs, account verification). Customer wants VPC-only deployment + HSM-backed KMS and full audit trails.

Recent activity/timeline:
- 2025-11-15: inbound lead from trade show; AE (Alexandra) opened initial call.
- 2025-12-02: discovery call — high level infra, compliance. Asked for SOC2 + pen test. (ff_20260218_01 attached).
- 2026-01-20: provided Redwood private deployment overview + prelim pricing (drive link).
- 2026-02-18: technical deep-dive with infra + security (Fireflies ff_20260218_01). Discussed VPC peering, restricted egress, and tool-calling patterns.
- 2026-03-02: POC scope agreed in principle: 6-week evaluation, 3 seat agent-assist trial, ticket summarization pipeline, secure tool-calling to internal CRM. (ff_20260302_arch_review).
- 2026-03-05: security sent list of required controls; Redwood to produce network diagram and DPA redline.

Use-case / requirements (short):
- Primary: agent-assist (real-time snippets + suggested replies) and automated ticket summarization for PCI-scope cases.
- Secondary: orchestrated tool-calling (internal CRM actions) requiring signed egress allowlist and signed function calls.
- Performance: expect peak spikes during merchant settlement windows — target P95 end-to-end latency < 350ms for assist responses under 500 concurrent agents.
- Throughput: avg 20k messages/day in pilot, scale plan to 200k/day.
- Model preferences: prefer smaller quantized variants for cost in fallback, but require a verified high-quality variant for sensitive flows. Must support model pinning + automatic fallback.

Security/compliance notes:
- VPC-only control plane; no public internet egress for request payloads.
- KMS/HSM required for key material; customer will provide BYOK options.
- Audit log retention policy: 7 years for PCI-relevant events; need log export to customer SIEM (S3/GCS syslog).
- SSO via SAML + least-privilege roles in Console.
- Data residency: production in us-east and us-west only; no EU replication for PCI workloads.

POC plan / success criteria:
- Week 1: VPC peering + network validation, sample event flow, Red-team / security checklist pass.
- Weeks 2-4: integrate agent-assist SDK into 3 agent desktops; validate latency and suggested reply accuracy on 200 sample conversations.
- Weeks 5-6: enable secure tool-calling to CRM staging, validate audit trail and replayability, verify retention/export.
- Success = functionally equivalent agent assists, P95 latency target met, security checklist green, legal signs SOW.

Stated customer sentiment / quotes:
- "We can't have model outputs logged to public buckets — audit trail must live in our VPC and be immutable." — Head of Security
- "Need to demonstrate deterministic fallback during settlement spikes; downtime is unacceptable." — Support Ops Lead
